Import from FASTPANEL: in “Import data” choose “FASTPANEL” (or “Other server over SSH”) and enter the address, the root user and an SSH password or key. The panel reads websites, databases, FTP and mail from FASTPANEL itself and, if that fails, inspects the nginx and MySQL settings. Websites with files, databases with their old passwords, FTP users and mail (mailboxes with their old passwords and messages) with their old passwords and cron jobs are moved; verified against a real FASTPANEL. Yandex Disk and WebDAV: “Check connection” now runs every step of a backup (sign-in, free space, folder, writing 64 B and 2 MB, reading, deleting) and on failure shows the server’s answer for each step; a lack of free space is reported directly; folders are created only when missing. In the backup table the “Stored” column now says “Cloud” for every cloud (Yandex Disk, Mail.ru, Dropbox, Google Drive, S3) instead of “FTP”.

Yandex Disk and other WebDAV storage: fixed uploading backups when the server answers “500”. Uploads now use HTTP/1.1 without an extra content type and, for large files, “Expect: 100-continue” (the server can refuse before any data is sent); on temporary server errors (500, 503) the backup is sent again up to four times, and the error message shows the explanation given by the server.

Cloud storage for backups: Yandex Disk, Mail.ru Cloud and any WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud) with a login and an app password, plus Dropbox and Google Drive through an access grant in your account. Each can be used as “In the cloud” or “Here and in the cloud”; backups are found, restored and deleted just like with S3, and the settings are moved during import. Two-step authentication (QR code, codes from Google Authenticator, Yandex Key and others, recovery codes) and access to the panel only from selected IP addresses in “Login protection”; if access is lost, reset them on the server with “itrupanel 2fa-off” and “itrupanel allow-all-ips”. Automatic panel updates in “Server information” (fixes only or all releases, at the chosen hour): off by default, manual updating remains.

ITRUPANEL is now free software: the source code is open on GitHub (github.com/ITRUpro/ITRUPANEL) under the GNU GPL version 3. The panel is still free, including for commercial work and hosting; you may study, modify and distribute it under the GPL-3.0. The name and logo are not licensed. Consent already given in the panel to the earlier terms stays valid; nothing needs to be accepted again. The license is described on the website and in the documentation (the “License and copyright” section).

Backups: a tidier list. Backups are no longer shown as one long list: each tab (“Website files”, “Databases”, “Panel settings”) shows one row per site, database or the panel — the number of backups, the latest date, the total size and where they are stored. Click a row to open all backups of that site, database or panel, newest first, with buttons for contents, download, restore and delete; the “← All sites” button returns to the overall list.

Backups: cloud storage. Backups can be kept in any S3-compatible cloud — Amazon S3, Yandex Object Storage, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO and others: the backup settings get the new options “In the cloud (S3)” and “Here and in the cloud”, ready-made service templates and a connection test. Large archives are uploaded in parts, backups are restored and deleted from the cloud, and backups already in the cloud are found by the “Find backups in the storage” button. The cloud settings are also moved during import from another panel. Keys are kept on the server and are hidden in the interface.
File manager: the code editor window now fills the whole screen height down to the Save and Cancel buttons; long files scroll inside the editor.

File manager: a code editor (CodeMirror) instead of the plain text field. Syntax highlighting for PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, YAML, SQL, Markdown, shell, Nginx, ini and other languages chosen by file name, line numbers, code folding, find and replace (including regular expressions), line wrapping, light and dark themes, saving with Ctrl/Cmd+S and an unsaved mark. It works offline; if the editor fails to load, the previous text field opens.

Fixed: after a power failure or a forced stop of the server the login protection log could stay empty and sign-in to the panel was blocked with “Login protection is temporarily unavailable”. The panel state and the protection log are now written with a flush to disk, and an empty or damaged log no longer blocks sign-in.

Import data: the backup settings for FTP can now be moved too (address, login, password, folder, parameters). The schedule on the new server stays off until you turn it on yourself, so two panels do not back up the same websites at the same time. Backups that already sit on the FTP are found and attached automatically.
